Title: A Day to Remember

Cast

1. Nikhil - 8 years, son
Look: blue T-shirt, khaki shorts
2. Neeta - 35 years, mother
Look: red salwar-kameez
3. Tanay - 12 years, friend
Look: glasses, green shirt, black trousers
4. Sharda - 72 years, grandmother
Look: white saree, glasses

Places

1. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
2. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The living room - Day

[Nikhil is sitting on a chair in the living room. Neeta stands near him.]

Neeta: "What lovely weather!"

[Nikhil stands up.]

Nikhil (happily): "Okay, Mom."

Scene 2: The courtyard - Day

Neeta: "So, here we are!"

[Nikhil shouts angrily.]

Nikhil: "I knew it!"

[Nikhil gets frightened and steps back.]

Nikhil (gently): "Hey, look at that!"

Scene 3: The living room - Day

[Nikhil stands in the living room. Neeta and Tanay stand near him.]

Nikhil: "Mom, look over here."

[Nikhil sweeps the floor with a broom.]

Nikhil: "Show me too!"

[Nikhil mops the floor.]

Nikhil (laughing): "Slowly, take it easy."

[Nikhil irons his school shirt.]

Tanay: "I really enjoyed today."
